missing_high_level_goals.project_description: Allow citizens to register an account and confirm it via email before they can submit reports.

actor.name: Citizens
actor.description: Individuals who want to use Participium to report urban issues

missing_high_level_goals.source_evidence: Documentation A: "Citizens can submit reports only if they have registered in the system with a username, first name, and last name... the user gets an email with a confirmation link... the registration becomes valid only after confirming through that link."
missing_high_level_goals.rationale: Current HLGs assume citizens can submit reports but do not capture the prerequisite of account registration and email verification, which is an autonomous WHY‑level intention.

missing_high_level_goals.project_description: Enable citizens to submit reports anonymously, hiding their identity from the public list of reports.

actor.name: Citizens
actor.description: Registered users who may wish to keep their identity private

missing_high_level_goals.source_evidence: Documentation A: "After entering all the information and the pictures, the system asks the citizen whether they want the report to be anonymous (the name will not appear in the public list of all reports)."
missing_high_level_goals.rationale: Anonymity is a distinct stakeholder intention not covered by any existing HLG.

missing_high_level_goals.project_description: Allow citizens to follow other citizens' open reports and receive notifications about their status changes.

actor.name: Citizens
actor.description: Registered users who want to stay informed about reports of interest

missing_high_level_goals.source_evidence: Documentation C: "Once logged into Participium, citizens can follow other citizens’ open reports and receive notifications (following the same rules as for their own reports)."
missing_high_level_goals.rationale: Current HLGs address notifications for a citizen’s own reports but omit the ability to follow and be notified about others’ reports.

missing_high_level_goals.project_description: Provide an interface that allows external chat‑bots to send messages to reporting citizens through the platform.

actor.name: Municipal Operators
actor.description: Staff responsible for configuring and maintaining communication channels in Participium

missing_high_level_goals.source_evidence: Documentation C: "The system must allow this functionality to be accessible by external chatbots as well."
missing_high_level_goals.rationale: Integration with external chat‑bots is a high‑level functional intention absent from the current HLG set.

missing_high_level_goals.project_description: Allow municipal administrators to grant or revoke Participium access for external maintenance companies.

actor.name: Municipal Administrators
actor.description: Administrators who configure system access and assignment rules

missing_high_level_goals.source_evidence: Documentation B: "Automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category to the external company (bypassing the initial review ...) is possible only if previously configured by the municipal administrator."
missing_high_level_goals.rationale: Managing external company access is an autonomous high‑level goal not covered by the existing HLGs.

observations: The current HLG set captures core reporting, lifecycle management, external maintenance interaction, automatic assignment, and public access, but omits several prerequisite, privacy, communication, and configuration intentions explicitly described in the documentation.
Confirmed reconstructed HLGs serve only as discovery cues and do not replace the need to verify coverage against the full documentation.

Coverage proposal verifier: Each selected proposal is explicitly documented, represents an autonomous WHY‑level functional intention not covered by existing HLGs, and does not duplicate another selected goal. Proposals 005 and 006 were excluded as they contain UI‑specific details or refinements rather than independent high‑level goals.
